Every kind of href a crawler meets

Not linked from the index, so the ordinary crawl graph stays stable. Crawl tests seed this page directly.

Should be followed

  • absolute path
  • relative path
  • same page, different fragment
  • the same page again, no fragment
  • tracking parameters only
  • the same page again, untracked
  • trailing slash

Should never be followed

  • mailto
  • tel
  • javascript
  • a download
  • another download
  • sign out
  • sign out, nested
  • another origin
  • nofollow
